Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.clients

Record Class ClientRegistration

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.clients.ClientRegistration
Record Components:
clientId - public identifier of the client.
name - human readable name.
confidential - true for a client able to keep a secret, false for a public client.
authMethods - client authentication methods, for example client_secret_basic or none.
grantTypes - grant types the client may use, for example authorization_code.
redirectUris - redirect URIs the client may use.
scopes - scopes the client may request.
requireProofKey - whether the authorization code flow must use PKCE.
audiences - logical identifiers of the APIs the access tokens are meant for (the aud claim); the client id when none is given.
accessTokenTtl - lifetime of access tokens.
refreshTokenTtl - lifetime of refresh tokens.
accessTokenFormat - self-contained or reference.
reuseRefreshTokens - true to keep a refresh token after use, false to rotate it.
postLogoutRedirectUris - URIs an end-user may be redirected to after an OpenID Connect RP-initiated logout; a post_logout_redirect_uri that is not listed is never honoured.
requireConsent - whether the end-user must explicitly grant the requested scopes on a consent page.
mfaRequired - whether every user signing in through the client must complete a second factor.
public record ClientRegistration(String clientId, String name, boolean confidential, List<String> authMethods, List<String> grantTypes, List<String> redirectUris, List<String> scopes, boolean requireProofKey, List<String> audiences, Duration accessTokenTtl, Duration refreshTokenTtl, String accessTokenFormat, boolean reuseRefreshTokens, List<String> postLogoutRedirectUris, boolean requireConsent, boolean mfaRequired) extends Record
An OAuth 2.1 client registered with the authorization server. The client secret is not part of the model: it is only ever handled encoded, through the repository.

    • ClientRegistration

      public ClientRegistration(String clientId, String name, boolean confidential, List<String> authMethods, List<String> grantTypes, List<String> redirectUris, List<String> scopes, boolean requireProofKey, List<String> audiences, Duration accessTokenTtl, Duration refreshTokenTtl, String accessTokenFormat, boolean reuseRefreshTokens, List<String> postLogoutRedirectUris, boolean requireConsent, boolean mfaRequired)

      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the id, name or format is blank, a collection is null or has a null element, a lifetime is missing or not positive, or a public client does not require PKCE.
